fact_flags.fact: the Montreal Protocol and Kigali Amendment govern the phase-out of ozone-depleting and hydrofluorocarbon substances (summary)
fact_flags.problem: Booklet says the Kigali Amendment mandates a phase-down of HFCs, not a phase-out; the summary overstates it.

fact_flags.fact: CosmoCube and PRATUSH are proposed Indian and international missions (summary)
fact_flags.problem: Booklet describes PRATUSH as the Indian project (Raman Research Institute with ISRO) and CosmoCube as led by scientists associated with the Royal Astronomical Society and University of Cambridge; the summary's Indian/international ordering misattributes CosmoCube as Indian.
